name: UNC Health Rex VolunTEEN Program
what_you_do: Help at a hospital in Raleigh for one shift a week. You may greet people, check on patient rooms, help patients go home, stock supplies, bring flowers, or run errands for nurses.
grades: 10th to 12th grade (finished 9th grade before the program starts)
who_can_apply: Teens 14 to 18 in 10th, 11th or 12th grade. You must be done with 9th grade before it starts.
duration: 8 weeks, June 21 to August 13, 2027. One 4-hour morning or afternoon shift a week, Monday to Friday. Only one absence allowed.
deadline_text: The 2027 Summer application is online only from March 11, 2027 to March 12, 2027. Interviews March 22 to 25, orientation April 26 to 29, and you must volunteer the first week (June 21 to 25).
how_to_apply: Fill out the form online. Two adults who know you, 21 or older and not family, email a reference form. This can be a teacher, a school counselor, or a boss. If they call you, go to an interview.
notes: There is also an Academic Year Program (one day a week, 3 to 5 PM, September to May), but it is closed for 2026 to 2027. If accepted, you need a health screening (TB, whooping cough, chicken pox, MMR). Questions: volsvcs1@unchealth.unc.edu or 919-784-3165.
